questions.question: A deposited Rs. 62,500 at the rate of 8% per annum compounded half yearly, then what is the compound interest at the end of two years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = Rs. 62,500

Rate of interest (R) = 8% per annum compounded half yearly

Time (T) = 2 years

**Formula Used:**

Compound Interest = P(1 + R/n)ⁿt - P

Where,

P = Principal amount,

R = Annual interest rate (in decimal),

n = Number of times the interest is compounded per year,

t = Time the money is invested for in years.

**Calculation:**

Since the interest is compounded half yearly, n = 2.

R = 8% = 0.08 (in decimal)

⇒ Compound Interest = 62500(1 + 0.08/2)²×² - 62500

⇒ Compound Interest = 62500(1 + 0.04)⁴ - 62500

⇒ Compound Interest = 62500(1.04)⁴ - 62500

⇒ Compound Interest = 62500 × (1.16985856) - 62500

⇒ Compound Interest = 73116.16 - 62500

⇒ Compound Interest = Rs. 10,616.16

**The compound interest at the end of two years is Rs. 10,616.16.**

questions.question: A man and woman working on alternate days can finish a work in 15 days if the man works on the first day. The same work is finished in 14.5 days if they work on alternate days and if the woman starts on the first day. The work will be finished by a man alone in __________ days.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__ **

If the man works on the first day, work will be completed in 15 days,

i.e. on 15 days, a man will work

M + W + M + W + ........ + M 

So, total work = 7M + 7W + M = 8M + 7W

if the woman works on the first day, work will be completed in 14.5 days,

i.e. on 15 days (last day), a woman will work

W + M + W + M.......+W

So, total work = 7W + 7M + 0.5W = 7.5W + 7W

Now,

8M + 7W = 7.5W + 7W

M = 0.5W

M/W = 1/2

Thus, total work = 8M + 7W = 8×1 + 7×2 = 8 + 14 = 22

So, time taken by a man to finish the work = 22/1 = **22 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__ **

**Given:**

Man and woman working on alternate days finish work in 15 days if man starts first.

They finish work in 14.5 days if woman starts first.

**Formula Used:**

Work Done = Rate × Time

**Calculation:**

Let the work done by the man in one day be M and by the woman be W.

When the man starts first, total work = (M + W) × 7.5 = 15M (since work is finished in 15 days, implying 7.5 cycles of man-woman)

⇒ 7.5M + 7.5W = 15M

⇒ 7.5W = 7.5M

⇒ W = M

When the woman starts first, total work = (M + W) × 7 + W = 14.5M (since work is finished in 14.5 days, implying 7 cycles of woman-man plus one day of woman's work)

⇒ 7M + 7W + W = 14.5M

⇒ 14M + 8W = 14.5M (since W = M)

⇒ 14M + 8M = 14.5M

⇒ 22M = 14.5M

⇒ M = 14.5 / 22

So, the man alone can finish the work in 1 / M days.

⇒ 1 / (14.5 / 22) = 22 days

**Therefore, the man alone can finish the work in 22 days.**

questions.question: If the cost price of 12 mangoes is equal to the selling price of 16 mangoes, then the loss percentage is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) of 12 mangoes = Selling Price (SP) of 16 mangoes.

**Formula Used:**

Loss % = [(Cost Price - Selling Price) / Cost Price] × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price of 1 mango be $1.

⇒ CP of 12 mangoes = 12 × $1 = $12

Given that CP of 12 mangoes = SP of 16 mangoes,

⇒ SP of 16 mangoes = $12

⇒ SP of 1 mango = $12 / 16 = $0.75

Loss per mango = CP - SP = $1 - $0.75 = $0.25

Loss % = [(0.25 / 1) × 100]% = 25%

**The loss percentage is 25%.**

questions.question: A boat covers a distance of 65 km downstream in 5 hours while it takes 13 hours to cover the same distance upstream. What is the speed of the boat in still water?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Downstream speed (D) = 65 ÷ 5 = 13 km/h

Upstream speed (U) = 65 ÷ 13 = 5 km/h

Speed of boat in still water = (D + U) ÷ 2

⇒ (13 + 5) ÷ 2 = 9 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 9 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance covered downstream = 65 km

Time taken downstream = 5 hours

Distance covered upstream = 65 km

Time taken upstream = 13 hours

**Formula Used:**

Speed = Distance ÷ Time

Speed of boat in still water = (Downstream Speed + Upstream Speed) ÷ 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fa5321f6017f29a33c9efdf896bbb5d575e3f69b6e4154646c0bb0454697d7a.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Downstream Speed = 65 ÷ 5 = 13 km/h

⇒ Upstream Speed = 65 ÷ 13 = 5 km/h

⇒ Speed of boat in still water = (13 + 5) ÷ 2

⇒ Speed of boat in still water = 18 ÷ 2 = 9 km/h

**∴ The correct answer is 9 km/h.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Speed of Stream

It is the speed at which the river flows. Formula: Speed of stream = (Downstream speed − Upstream speed) ÷ 2.

Downstream Speed

When a boat travels in the direction of the flow of the stream. Formula: Downstream speed = Speed of boat + Speed of stream.

Upstream Speed

When a boat travels against the direction of the flow of the stream. Formula: Upstream speed = Speed of boat − Speed of stream.

questions.question: The average weight of A, B and C is 43 kg. If the average weight of A and B is 40 kg and that of B and C is 41 kg, then the weight (in kg) of B is?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average weight of A, B, and C = 43 kg.

Average weight of A and B = 40 kg.

Average weight of B and C = 41 kg.

**Formula Used:**

Average weight of two or more items = (Sum of their weights) / (Number of items)

**Calculation:**

Let the weights of A, B, and C be A kg, B kg, and C kg respectively.

⇒ (A + B + C) / 3 = 43

⇒ A + B + C = 129

⇒ (A + B) / 2 = 40

⇒ A + B = 80

⇒ (B + C) / 2 = 41

⇒ B + C = 82

Adding A + B = 80 and B + C = 82,

⇒ A + 2B + C = 162

Subtracting A + B + C = 129 from A + 2B + C = 162,

⇒ 2B + C - (B + C) = 162 - 129

⇒ B = 33 kg

**The weight of B is 33 kg.**

questions.question: Vinita obtained an amount of Rs. 23,340 as simple interest on a certain amount at 15% per annum after 8 years. What was the amount invested by Vinita?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Simple Interest = Rs. 23,340, Rate = 15% per annum, Time = 8 years.

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest = (Principal × Rate × Time) / 100

**Calculation:**

Let the principal amount be P.

⇒ 23340 = (P × 15 × 8) / 100

⇒ 23340 = (120P) / 100

⇒ 23340 × 100 = 120P

⇒ P = 23340 × 100 / 120

⇒ P = Rs. 19,450

**The amount invested by Vinita was Rs. 19,450.**

questions.question: The largest three-digit number which gives the same remainder 2 when divided by 3, 5 and 9 is ____________.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The number should give the same remainder 2 when divided by 3, 5, and 9.

**Formula Used:**

The number should be in the form of lcm(3, 5, 9)k + 2, where k is an integer.

**Calculation:**

First, find the LCM of 3, 5, and 9.

LCM of 3, 5, and 9 = 45

The number should be of the form 45k + 2.

To find the largest three-digit number, we start with the largest three-digit number, 999, and subtract 2 to make it divisible by 3, 5, and 9.

999 - 2 = 997

Now, find the largest multiple of 45 that is less than or equal to 997.

997 / 45 = 22 remainder

So, the largest multiple of 45 less than 997 is 45 × 22 = 990

Adding 2 to align with our original form (45k + 2) gives us 990 + 2 = 992

**The largest three-digit number which gives the same remainder 2 when divided by 3, 5, and 9 is 992.**

questions.question: A can complete a piece of work in 20 days. B can complete the same work in 36 days. If A and B work together, then the number of days required to complete the work is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can complete the work in 20 days.

B can complete the work in 36 days.

**Concept Used:**

Work rate of A = 1/20 of the work per day.

Work rate of B = 1/36 of the work per day.

Combined work rate of A and B = (1/20) + (1/36).

**Calculation:**

⇒ Combined work rate = (9 + 5)/180 = 14/180 = 7/90 of the work per day.

⇒ Number of days required = 1 / (7/90) = 90/7.

⇒ Number of days = 90/7 = 12 (6)/(7) 

⇒ Number of days = 12 (6)/(7) 

**∴ A and B together will complete the work in 12 (6)/(7) **

questions.question: What is the fourth proportional to 816, 226, 408?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

First number = 816

Second number = 226

Third number = 408

**Formula Used:**

If a, b, c, d are in proportion, then a:b :: c:d or a/b = c/d

**Calculation:**

Let the fourth proportional to 816, 226, and 408 be x.

Therefore, 816:226 :: 408:x

⇒ 816/226 = 408/x

⇒ x = (408 × 226) / 816

⇒ x = 92,208 / 816

⇒ x = 113

**The fourth proportional is 113.**

questions.question: If the price of a product is decreased by 50%, then increased by 50% and then again increased by 50%, what is the net increase percentage in the price?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Initial decrease in price = 50%

First increase in price = 50%

Second increase in price = 50%

**Formula Used:**

Final price = Initial price × (1 - Decrease%) × (1 + First Increase%) × (1 + Second Increase%)

Net Increase% = [(Final Price - Initial Price) / Initial Price] × 100

**Calculation:**

Let the initial price be 100 units.

⇒ After a 50% decrease, the new price = 100 × (1 - 0.5) = 100 × 0.5 = 50 units

⇒ After a 50% increase, the new price = 50 × (1 + 0.5) = 50 × 1.5 = 75 units

⇒ After another 50% increase, the new price = 75 × (1 + 0.5) = 75 × 1.5 = 112.5 units

⇒ Net Increase = 112.5 - 100 = 12.5 units

⇒ Net Increase% = (12.5 / 100) × 100 = 12.5%

**The net increase percentage in the price is 12.5%.**

questions.question: The marks scored by a student are directly proportional to the time invested in studies. If the student gets 60 marks when he studies 4 hours a day, then how many hours he should use in his studies daily to get 75 marks?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Marks scored with 4 hours of study = 60 marks.

**Formula Used:**

Since marks are directly proportional to the time invested in studies,

Marks = k × Time, where k is the proportionality constant.

**Calculation:**

60 = k × 4

⇒ k = 60 / 4

⇒ k = 15

To get 75 marks,

75 = 15 × Time

⇒ Time = 75 / 15

⇒ Time = 5 hours

**Therefore, the student should study 5 hours daily to get 75 marks.**

questions.question: The distance covered (in km) by a bus in 55 minutes at a speed of 69 km/h is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the bus = 69 km/h.

Time = 55 minutes = 55/60 hours.

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

**Calculation:**

First, convert time into hours,

Time = 55/60 hours = 11/12 hours

Distance = Speed × Time

Distance = 69 × (11/12)

Distance = 63.25 km

**The distance covered by the bus in 55 minutes at a speed of 69 km/h is 63.25 km.**

questions.question: The cost price of an item is Rs. 4,850. What is the profit percentage (rounded off to 1 decimal place) if it is sold at Rs. 6,680?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = Rs. 4,850

Selling Price (SP) = Rs. 6,680

**Formula Used:**

Profit Percentage = (Profit / CP) × 100

Profit = SP - CP

**Calculation:**

Profit = SP - CP

⇒ Profit = 6,680 - 4,850

⇒ Profit = Rs. 1,830

Profit Percentage = (Profit / CP) × 100

⇒ Profit Percentage = (1,830 / 4,850) × 100

⇒ Profit Percentage = (1830 / 4850) × 100

⇒ Profit Percentage = 0.3773 × 100

⇒ Profit Percentage = 37.73

**The profit percentage is 37.7%.**

**Given:**

Radius of the cone = 10.5 cm

Curved surface area of the cone = 396 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Curved surface area of the cone = π × radius × slant height

**Calculation:**

Let's denote the slant height by l.

Using the given formula: 396 = (22/7) × 10.5 × l

⇒ 396 = 33 × l

⇒ l = 396 / 33

⇒ l = 12 cm

**The slant height of the cone is 12 cm.**

questions.question: Find the volume of a cuboid whose dimensions are 12.2 cm, 16 cm and 8.5 cm.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Length of the cuboid = 12.2 cm.

Breadth of the cuboid = 16 cm.

Height of the cuboid = 8.5 cm.

**Formula Used:**

Volume of cuboid = Length × Breadth × Height

**Calculation:**

Volume = 12.2 cm × 16 cm × 8.5 cm

Volume = 1659.2 cm³

**The volume of the cuboid is 1659.2 cm³.**
